_comment: Fictional, optional model-readable preferences. This file does not enable automation or authorize submission. Real preferences and evidence remain profile-local.

applicationQualityPolicy.selection: Read the full employer JD and verified evidence. Report strong matches and domain stretches separately; carry unfilled strong-match slots forward.
applicationQualityPolicy.tailoring: Choose the appropriate base; tailor headline, evidence selection and bullet order. Review actual page one and the most relevant recent role's first two bullets.
applicationQualityPolicy.answers: Use verified examples and outcomes; preserve submitted packages and answers.
applicationQualityPolicy.execution: Reuse portal lessons; wait for save/upload completion; verify employer receipts and reconcile email separately; close only completed task-owned tabs.

compensationPolicy.advertisedRange: Use the exact midpoint of the applicable employer base-pay range for the candidate geography and level, with explicit currency and pay period. Round only when required by the form.
compensationPolicy.noAdvertisedRange: Research current comparable employer ranges by country, currency, role family, seniority and scope. Adjust the target for more senior scope; document sources and reasoning.
compensationPolicy.evidence: Record the question, applicable range or comparable sources, observation dates, calculation, currency/pay period and exact submitted answer in per-job notes.
